messages.body: **Air: one more constants row, the one only a long literal can test.** The funnel ports `FloatDecimal`, whose buffer holds 800 digits plus a `truncated` flag, and that flag decides a tie when digits are dropped (`sawc/std/float.saw` ~2257: "The tie — a lone `5` with nothing after it — is where `truncated` earns" its place). None of the listed values exceeds 800 digits AND sits on a tie, so a port that drops the flag would pass the whole matrix. Add a literal on the halfway point between two doubles with a nonzero digit past the buffer: `9007199254740993.` followed by 800 zeros and a `1`. That must round UP to `9007199254740994` (`…994`); the same text without the final `1` ties to even, `…992`. Both bit patterns come from the Stage 0 oracle (Python `float()`).
